title: Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program
summary: OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.
body: OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了面向小企业的ChatGPT项目，旨在帮助创业者学习AI技能、实现工作流程自动化，并通过ChatGPT Work实现业务增长。原始信息显示：OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出面向小型企业的ChatGPT专属项目，推动大模型在中小微企业的普及落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
